solution.title: macOS Endpoint Management Baseline in Microsoft Intune

products.name: macOS Endpoint Management Baseline in Microsoft Intune — Commercial
products.short_description: Establish the foundational macOS management baseline in Intune — config profiles, restrictions, compliance, and update management — so every Mac meets corporate standards, deployed pilot-first. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Give every Mac a consistent, compliant Intune baseline

Macs enrolled in Intune without a deliberate baseline drift into inconsistent, non-compliant states. This solution establishes the foundational macOS management baseline in Microsoft Intune — configuration profiles (settings catalog and custom .mobileconfig), device restrictions, compliance policies, and software-update management — so every Mac meets corporate standards for security, performance, and user experience, deployed pilot-first and rollback-ready.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the macOS management model in Intune (MDM protocol, config profiles, settings catalog vs custom .mobileconfig, compliance, update management) and the standard deployment model.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune + Entra licensing, APNs certificate, enrollment method, Entra groups, a pilot group) with how to verify and implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact ordered steps to build the named baseline configuration profiles, restrictions, compliance policies, and macOS software-update policy, assign to a pilot, validate, and expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — baseline discovery, per-device applied-state validation, a config/compliance coverage report, safe remediation of drifted devices, and a target-group builder (Microsoft Graph).
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with pass/fail gates, plus Best Practices for naming, settings catalog, and update rings.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Every Mac on a consistent, compliant Intune baseline — secure, performant, and predictable — proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • MACBASE-Discovery.ps1 — tenant/device readiness for a macOS management baseline (management plane, Graph)
    • MACBASE-Remediation.ps1 — safely reapply/repair a drifted macOS baseline (management plane, Graph)
    • MACBASE-Report.ps1 — fleet macOS baseline posture + drift via Microsoft Graph (Intune macOS objects)
    • MACBASE-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — add a group assignment to the macOS baseline policies (management plane, Graph)
    • MACBASE-Validation.ps1 — per-device applied-state check for the macOS baseline (management plane, Graph)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
